cases.input: Validate the deployment of demo-service that just completed. Operational scope: read-only gcp-observe tools only. Success criteria: all four protocol stages executed with baseline comparison; verdict stated; no mutations.
Incident drill: error rate on demo-service has tripled in the last 30 minutes. Investigate with parallel hypotheses, quantify blast radius, deliver the postmortem and comms drafts.
Run a FinOps sweep of this project: idle and over-provisioned resources, anomaly correlation, savings ranked with draft remediations.
Review this design: a single-region Cloud Run service with a public unauthenticated endpoint writing directly to a shared Postgres. Produce the standard governance review.
